title: Matthew Slade, Private Investigator
paragraphs: A short-lived private-detective series following Matthew Slade through murder and mystery cases. Surviving documentation is limited, so this catalog avoids adding unsupported biographical or broadcast details.

KPFK/Pacifica private-eye revival starring William Wintersole as Matthew Slade, also billed as Starlight Mystery Theatre. Frozen subset has eight recordings spanning confirmed 1964 originals, a 1965 rebroadcast identity, and one date-uncertain KPFK/KPFA aircheck.

GRH documents the program through KPFK/Starlight Mystery Theatre original run (July 5, 1964 to November 22, 1964) on [[org|org.081e01eef424ad61|KPFK]] and Repeat and service-syndication era (1965 to 1968) on [[org|org.081e01eef424ad61|KPFK]].

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are William Wintersole (performer on 8 recordings), director) (performer on 7 recordings), Brian Adams (writer (performer on 6 recordings), Robert Frederick (writer on 6 recordings), Brian Adams (director on 5 recordings and writer on 5 recordings), Joyce Reed (performer on 2 recordings), and Michael Dayton (technical director on 1 recording and technical producer on 1 recording).
The program is also connected in the archive to [[org|org.cd82fd99edb39caa|Armed Forces Radio and Television Service]] (rebroadcast by) and [[org|org.081e01eef424ad61|KPFK]] (originated at station).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include private detective investigation, KPFK/Pacifica radio drama, AFRTS service syndication, murder investigation, and mid-century private-eye drama revival.
GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including 1964 KPFK private-eye radio revival and 1965-1968 repeat and service-syndication life.
